mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the past month indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates weakening manufacturing activity and impending economic deceleration, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines and the economy is in a late-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 5.0% and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%).

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market, indicated by rising non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS), supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A high inflation rate (CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.0%) signals potential monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is high, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL annualized change > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines and the economy is in an early-cycle expansion (UNRATE < 5.0% and GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%).
